about: Port exhaustion and RPC checks for the Guided Diagnostics scenario RPC or port exhaustion (Windows). The ranges, delays, thresholds and the events counted. A value listed under set_by is a SAT starting value with no figure in the source read; the others follow the page named in source. The step texts are in scenarios.json.

usage.set_by: attention_percent is SAT; fail_percent follows the Directory Services article
usage.not_counted_note: Ports in the BOUND state are not in the socket table, so the counts are a lower bound.

handles.set_by: nonpaged_pool_attention_percent_of_ram is SAT; the handle figures are Microsoft's

rpc.set_by: in_use_attention_percent is SAT; the minimum follows the source

events.meaning: A request for an ephemeral TCP port failed because all of them were in use.
A connection failed because its local port was recently used for the same remote endpoint; connections are opened and closed at a high rate.
A request for an ephemeral UDP port failed because all of them were in use. Also logged on machines that work normally.
The Server service could not allocate from the system nonpaged pool because the pool was empty.
The Server service could not allocate from the system paged pool because the pool was empty.
The Netlogon service could not add the AuthZ RPC interface. Logged when the RPC port configuration is wrong or the pool is too small.

error_meanings.name: RPC_S_OUT_OF_RESOURCES
error_meanings.meaning: Not enough resources are available to complete this operation.

error_meanings.name: RPC_S_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
error_meanings.meaning: The RPC server is unavailable. Logged when a lower layer reports a connectivity failure.

error_meanings.name: RPC_S_SERVER_TOO_BUSY
error_meanings.meaning: The RPC server is too busy to complete this operation.

error_meanings.name: EPT_S_NOT_REGISTERED
error_meanings.meaning: There are no more endpoints available from the endpoint mapper.

error_meanings.name: WSAEACCES
error_meanings.meaning: Permission denied. A bind to a port inside an excluded port range gives this.

error_meanings.name: WSAEADDRINUSE
error_meanings.meaning: Address already in use: another socket holds this protocol, address and port.

error_meanings.name: WSAENOBUFS
error_meanings.meaning: No buffer space available: the system lacked buffer space or a queue was full.

error_meanings.name: WSAECONNREFUSED
error_meanings.meaning: Connection refused: nothing listens on the target port.
